title: Pocket Money Calculator: a family allowance plan
subtitle: Short setup, quick or full quiz, then a plan with amount range, save/spend/give split, and partnership habits.
seoTitle: Kids Pocket Money Calculator | Family Plan | DailyLogic
seoDescription: Free kids allowance calculator: age and model setup, quick or 25-question blueprint. Get a monthly range, save/spend/give split, and practical tips — all in your browser.
heroDescription: Allowance works when the partnership is clear: amount, rules, saving, and what happens when money runs out. This tool helps parent and child align and build a practical plan.

sections.heading: What this calculator does
paragraphs: Before the quiz you choose age, allowance model, and goal — so wording and advice fit. Then pick quick setup or a full family blueprint.
Questions cover responsibility, saving, family partnership, and spending wisdom — with age and model tweaks.
The report includes a recommended monthly range, percentage split, insights, tips, and habits. Everything stays local in the browser.

sections.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Fill the background with your child, choose quiz length, and answer on a frequency scale with a clear progress bar.
Save to history (Expand on the home page) or download/copy a result card.
Use the plan as a conversation starter — not a verdict.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: Allowance without rules becomes arguments. Simple structure builds responsibility and trust.
Age-aware guidance prevents unrealistic expectations — in amount and in language.
Re-running after a few months shows whether habits actually stuck.

faq.question: Do we have to answer with the child?
faq.answer: Strongly recommended — it’s a partnership. Parents can also fill it as prep for a talk.

faq.question: Is the recommended amount mandatory?
faq.answer: No. It’s an educational guide by age and responsibility — adapt it to your household.

faq.question: Is data stored on a server?
faq.answer: No. Everything runs and saves locally in the browser.
